name: product_sign
description: Complete a sentence naming the sign of a two-integer product; controls name the sign of the first explicitly signed factor, using the same answer vocabulary.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];controls=[]
for i in range(120):
 a=random.randint(1,30)*(-1 if i%2 else 1);b=random.randint(1,30)*(-1 if (i//2)%2 else 1)
 items.append({'prompt':f'The product of {a} and {b} is a','answer':' '+('positive' if a*b>0 else 'negative')})
 controls.append({'prompt':f'Given the integers {a} and {b}, the first integer is a','answer':' '+('positive' if a>0 else 'negative')})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
